title: Actual source-normalization and finite-class predicate types
statement: For a prime ell and scheme W, let Q_n be sheaves of modules over the actual residue ring at level n. Define sheafKummerFinitePredicate to be the type of predicates, for every n, on Ext^2 from the p-adic restriction of Q_n to the p-adic restriction of the canonical residue line. Given a simultaneous derived reduction D and source S, define sheafKummerSourcePredicate to be the type of predicates on isomorphisms from the actual ordinary reduction quotient of S at n to the p-adic restriction of Q_n. Both definitions are the literal function types and choose no data or proofs. The underlying interface is [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] with the checked small-Ext witnesses [lem-sfb-canonical-sheaf-ext].
